check_vasp_convergence: check if a VASP DFT calculation converged electronically using the OSZICAR output file
count_scf_steps: count total SCF and ionic steps from VASP OSZICAR output files in a directory
review_converged_oszicar: review the converged_oszicar function to understand VASP electronic convergence checking logic
refactor_converged_oszicar: refactor the converged_oszicar function to support custom convergence thresholds and frame indices
summarize_count_scf: summarize the count_scf function that tallies electronic and ionic steps from VASP outputs
